output.explanation:
The central tree retains the five conceptual components while reducing the seed from 116 to 77 lines (33.6%) and from 8,478 to 5,581 characters (34.2%). Five peripherals expand validation, retry semantics, record ownership, evidence transport, and diagram identity. M = modular structure, C = call flow, O = ownership, D = data dependency; these perspectives coexist within each tree. Edges attach to the relevant central concept, and positions leave measured gaps between text rectangles.

Grounding: conversation behavior comes from domain/core/agents/agentContext.ts; library and retry behavior from application/mapping/agent/agentContextLibrary.ts and domain/core/agents/savedAgentContext.ts; publication and locking from infrastructure/core/persistence/fileAgentContextRepository.ts; capture and transport from infrastructure/core/persistence/fileAgentContextSources.ts; diagram identity from domain/core/diagrams/diagramAgentContext.ts. Only the supplied point, sources, and seed were used as evidence.

Corrections and qualifications: trajectory cycle/missing-link checks cover the traversed ancestor slice, not the entire trajectory. The seed's stale-comment-hash failure claim needs an exception: an identical existing comment receipt returns before checking the current snapshot hash. Diagram loading validates backing identity but does not compare the saved fingerprint or revision against current evidence; the point's change-detection claim therefore requires caller behavior absent from these inputs. The background message requests the current diagram on later edits, but these files do not establish that callers supply it. Source-file checks use the 16 MiB constant despite stale 2 MiB error text and comments. Portable conversion recomputes the hash but need not change its value.

New peripheral details include missing-attachment acceptance during snapshot validation, repeated expansion byte accounting, noncanonical request hashing, cache eviction order, source-ID fallback, and full-record reads behind summaries. Implementations of imported source-range helpers, ImmutableRecords, and session-launch callers are not supplied; their internals and end-to-end session behavior remain unverified.

Reusable Agent Contexts
|-- [M] Validated conversation value: AgentContext
|   |-- Public boundary
|   |   |-- fromTrajectory / fromMessages / fromSnapshot -> validated context
|   |   |-- toSnapshot / withoutSourceFiles -> exported descriptor
|   |   `-- withMessages / resolveSources -> new value; toPiMessages -> model input
|   |-- Internal invariants
|   |   |-- Walk throughEntryId -> parents -> fromEntryId; reverse selected messages
|   |   |-- Reject duplicate entry IDs; reject missing links/cycles on traversed path
|   |   |-- Tool results must match pending call IDs/names before the next message
|   |   `-- Snapshot checks version, descriptor hash and supplied attachments
|   |-- [D] contentHash = SHA-256(canonical descriptor)
|   |   |-- Includes version, source identity, entry range and ordered messages
|   |   |-- Sections -> version 3; else source references -> 2; else -> 1
|   |   `-- Sort object keys; retain array order; exclude attached sourceFiles
|   |-- [O] Private snapshot cloned on construction/export; replacements are new values
|   `-- [C] Source expansion and model conversion
|       |-- resolveSources uses attached snapshot lines or an injected reader
|       |-- Replace references with text; preserve sections; recompute descriptor hash
|       `-- toPiMessages labels sections; unresolved references fail conversion
|-- [M] Reusable library: AgentContextLibrary
|   |-- Public: create, read, list, update, fork, addComment, lineage
|   |-- Depends on AgentContext and saved-record schemas
|   |   `-- I/O via injected repository and optional source adapter
|   |-- [C] create(context, metadata, requestId)
|   |   |-- Plain text -> user message; snapshot -> fromSnapshot validation
|   |   |-- Constituents/sections -> sequential capture; preserve names and order
|   |   `-- Optional source persistence -> repository.create -> saved ID + summary
|   |-- [D] Retry receipt: requestId -> saved ID; requestHash -> argument identity
|   |   |-- Constituent input checks receipt before recapturing sources
|   |   `-- Same receipt returns saved record; conflicting UUID reuse fails
|   |-- [C] read / list
|   |   |-- read returns pinned snapshot/hash plus optional resolvedSnapshot
|   |   `-- list filters name/description -> newest-first summaries -> pagination
|   |-- [C] fork -> new saved ID with copied snapshot and parent ID/hash
|   |   |-- Check retry receipt first; otherwise require current parent hash
|   |   `-- Inherit description/group unless overridden; comments stay on parent
|   |-- [D] lineage follows parent IDs -> root-first report with parentMatches
|   |   `-- Compare recorded parent hash to current parent; missing/cyclic ancestry fails
|   `-- [O] Group/comments are metadata; snapshot hash stays unchanged
|       |-- Comments record request UUID, text, timestamp and expected content hash
|       `-- Saved IDs span canvases/chats within the application store
|-- [M] Durable record adapter: FileAgentContextRepository
|   |-- Implements repository port; file naming and metadata mutation are private
|   |-- read parses record, verifies requested ID and validates snapshot
|   |-- [O] Create: exclusive temporary file -> write/sync/close -> hard-link final ID
|   |   `-- Sync directory -> read published record -> compare receipt -> remove temp
|   `-- [O] Metadata: acquire per-record lock -> read/mutate/validate -> atomic rename
|       |-- Retry lock every 10 ms for up to 5 seconds; timeout -> AGENT_CONTEXT_BUSY
|       `-- Sync file/directory; finally close handles and remove temp/acquired lock
|-- [M] Shared evidence adapter: FileAgentContextSources
|   |-- Public: capture / read / persist / portable
|   |   `-- Depends on source bindings, corpus provider, Git and ImmutableRecords
|   |-- [C] capture(sourceId, path, line range, optional revision)
|   |   |-- Requested/bound revision -> resolve Git commit -> pinned regular file
|   |   `-- Otherwise read document; matching HEAD bytes -> Git; else snapshot blob
|   |-- [D] Source reference + pinned file + inclusive bounds -> selected text
|   |   |-- Git reference -> registered repository + commit + path
|   |   `-- Snapshot reference -> contentHash -> immutable source-file record
|   |-- [O] Retains snapshot blobs and at most 16 cached Git-read promises
|   |   `-- Cache key: root/commit/path; failed reads evicted for retry
|   |-- [C] persist validates, stores attachments and loads distinct references
|   |   `-- Returns descriptor without attachments; preserves descriptor hash
|   `-- [C] portable selects range lines, attaches them and rewrites reference hashes
|       `-- Rebuild context and recompute hash; unrelated file lines are omitted
`-- [M] Diagram evidence binding
    |-- Reuses AgentContext; exposes compile / validate / store / load functions
    |   `-- DiagramAgentContextStore owns backing I/O
    |-- [D] compile: originalLines + bounds -> attached source files + references
    |   |-- Binding/evidence metadata + references -> one background user message
    |   `-- SHA-256(JSON(binding + evidence)) -> sourceFingerprint; retain revision
    |-- [O] One backing form: inline snapshot OR backingRecordId + contentHash
    |   `-- store.put(snapshot) -> compact descriptor retaining diagram identity
    `-- [C] load validates descriptor -> inline snapshot or store.get(recordId)
        |-- Require snapshot hash when supplied, diagram-context type and diagram ID
        |-- Missing backing data or identity mismatch fails
        `-- No current-evidence comparison here; fingerprint is available to callers

Conversation validation and conversion
|-- [C] fromTrajectory selects one ancestor slice
|   |-- All entry IDs must be unique
|   |-- Missing links/cycles checked only along the walk
|   `-- Stop at fromEntryId; ancestors beyond it are not traversed
|-- [D] Tool-call completeness is a conversation invariant
|   |-- Assistant call ID -> pending tool name; IDs cannot repeat
|   |-- Result must match both ID and name; consume pending entry
|   `-- Non-result message or slice end requires no pending calls
|-- [C] fromSnapshot validates supplied data
|   |-- References require version >= 2; sections require version 3
|   |-- Attached file hash must match its key and a snapshot reference
|   |-- Check attached range bounds through sourceRangeText
|   `-- Missing attachments can pass; source availability is checked later
|-- [O] resolveSources has an operation-local promise cache
|   |-- Canonically identical references share reads
|   |-- Expanded UTF-8 bytes count every occurrence, including cache hits
|   |-- Split text into blocks of at most 1,000,000 string units
|   `-- Preserve source/range identity; drop attachments; version becomes 1 or 3
`-- [C] toPiMessages converts history without launching a session
    |-- Sections get opening/closing text labels; assistant tool calls survive
    |-- Imported assistants: provider=agent-context; zero usage/cost
    |-- stopReason is toolUse when calls exist, otherwise stop
    `-- Imported provenance never chooses the active session's model

Request receipts and metadata concurrency
|-- [D] Creation receipt hashes parsed input with JSON.stringify
|   |-- Constituents: [name, description, context, optional group]
|   |-- Text/snapshot: [name, description, contentHash, optional group]
|   `-- Unlike descriptor hashing, these arrays are not canonicalized
|-- [C] create retry reads saved-agent-context-<requestId>
|   |-- Constituents: compare receipt before source capture
|   |-- Text/snapshot: build/validate context before receipt lookup
|   `-- Metadata changes never rewrite the original creation receipt
|-- [C] fork receipt = SHA-256(JSON(['fork', parsed input]))
|   |-- Existing matching fork returns before reading/checking parent
|   |-- New fork checks expectedContentHash against parent snapshot
|   `-- Omitted group inherits; null clears; explicit group replaces
`-- [C] addComment runs inside the repository metadata lock
    |-- Existing commentId = requestId?
    |   |-- Same text and recorded hash -> return without a freshness check
    |   `-- Different text/hash -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
    `-- New comment UUID
        |-- Require expectedContentHash = current snapshot hash
        `-- Append comment with timestamp; retain model-visible content

Saved-record publication and resource ownership
|-- [O] Repository owns <root>/agent-contexts
|   `-- Validated saved ID selects one JSON file
|-- [C] create publishes through an exclusive temporary file
|   |-- Open with wx and mode 0600; write -> fsync -> close
|   |-- Hard-link temp to final path
|   |   `-- EEXIST keeps the winner; other link errors propagate
|   |-- Sync directory; read/validate winner; compare requestHash
|   `-- Finally remove temporary file
|-- [C] mutateMetadata coordinates writers with an ID-specific directory lock
|   |-- Retry EEXIST every 10 ms; 5-second deadline -> busy error
|   |-- Under lock: read -> mutate -> validate saved-record schema
|   |-- Write/sync/close temp -> rename over record -> sync directory
|   `-- Finally remove temp, then acquired lock
`-- [C] summaries performs full record reads before returning metadata
    |-- Missing directory -> empty array; missing file -> null read
    `-- Invalid records propagate errors; summaries contain no message bodies

Pinned evidence: capture, retention and transport
|-- [C] capture resolves a registered source binding
|   |-- Explicit revision wins over the Git binding's revision
|   |-- With revision: rev-parse <revision>^{commit}
|   |   `-- ls-tree requires one regular 100644/100755 blob; then git show
|   `-- Without revision: read corpus document text
|       |-- Compare whole-file hash to HEAD, when available
|       `-- Different bytes or failed HEAD lookup -> immutable snapshot
|-- [D] File representation and limits
|   |-- startLine=1; split on LF/CRLF; NUL text is rejected
|   |-- Actual source byte limit is 16 MiB via AGENT_CONTEXT_MAX_BYTES
|   `-- Error text/cache comment saying 2 MiB disagree with the constant
|-- [O] Git cache is adapter-owned; at most 16 root/commit/path promises
|   |-- Oldest inserted key evicted; hits do not refresh its position
|   `-- Rejection evicts only if that promise still occupies the key
|-- [C] persist separates evidence blobs from the descriptor
|   |-- Validate snapshot -> put all attached files -> load distinct references
|   `-- Remove attachments without changing descriptor hash
|-- [C] portable creates self-contained selected evidence
|   |-- Use supplied snapshot attachment when present; otherwise load file
|   |-- Slice inclusive range; preserve its original startLine
|   |-- Hash selected file -> rewrite sourceRange version to snapshot
|   `-- withMessages recomputes descriptor hash; it may stay equal
`-- [M] External boundaries used by this adapter
    |-- Corpus provider supplies document text; Git supplies committed bytes
    `-- ImmutableRecords supplies put/get; its implementation is not pinned here

Diagram evidence identity and backing lifecycle
|-- [D] compileDiagramAgentContext builds a background message
|   |-- Each range's originalLines -> file with range.startLine
|   |-- sourceId: evidence entry -> binding -> diagramId fallback
|   |-- Replace originalLines in metadata with a source reference
|   `-- Append references as message blocks; attach source files by hash
|-- [D] Two independent hashes
|   |-- contentHash authenticates the AgentContext descriptor
|   `-- sourceFingerprint = SHA-256(JSON.stringify({binding, evidence}))
|       `-- Uses original evidence; no canonical key sorting in this function
|-- [C] validate checks descriptor shape and backing identity
|   |-- diagram-/diagram-revision- prefixes; 64-hex fingerprints/hashes
|   |-- Inline: validate snapshot; reject simultaneous backingRecordId
|   `-- Stored: require contentHash and 64-hex backingRecordId
|-- [C] store validates, then returns existing stored form or calls put
|   `-- Returned record ID must be 64 hex; inline payload becomes a reference
`-- [C] load validates, gets backing data and checks snapshot identity
    |-- Inline contentHash may be omitted; snapshot's own hash is still checked
    |-- compiledFromRevisionId and fingerprint are not compared to a diagram
    `-- Background text requests current diagram per edit; caller flow is unshown
